interest: Records the Bank of Taiwan surrendering silver to China's Central Bank, and the Taiwan Colonization Company's creation.
overview: Two records: a 1937 Canton telegram on the Bank of Taiwan transferring about $500,000 in silver to the Central Bank of China, and a 1935 memo on the Taiwan Colonization Company.

people.name: William T. Turner
people.role: Officer, Division of Far Eastern Affairs

subfiles.about: Report on the Bank of Taiwan transferring its silver holdings in Canton and Swatow to the Central Bank of China.
subfiles.summary: Canton reports the Bank of Taiwan arranged to surrender its Canton and Swatow silver, about $500,000, to the Central Bank of China.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Canton on Bank of Taiwan Silver Holdings

subfiles.about: Memorandum concerning the organization of the Taiwan Colonization Company and the revival of the Taiwan Government-General's Foreign Affairs Section.
subfiles.summary: Far Eastern Affairs memo on the Taiwan Government-General's planned semi-official Taiwan Colonization Company and revived Foreign Affairs Section.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on Taiwan Colonization Company and Foreign Affairs Section
